Two additional source-partonomy findings are confirmed within this preparation-family issue: `W05-FINAL-CHEM-NEW-02` and `W05-FINAL-CHEM-NEW-03`. Their original before-fix reports and all four published payload hashes are preserved; this is a proposed correction, not acceptance of the full successor.

| Existing proposal | Primary evidence and supported whole-stock description |
|---|---|
| CHEM-C1193-HEPES-1221 and CHEM-C1193-HEPES-1474 | [NBRC1221](https://www.nite.go.jp/nbrc/catalogue/NBRCMediumDetailServlet?NO=1221) and [NBRC1474](https://www.nite.go.jp/nbrc/catalogue/NBRCMediumDetailServlet?NO=1474) specify a 1 M HEPES-KOH additive. The separately stated receiving-medium pH values do not specify stock pH. |
| CHEM-C1193-DSMZ_394_1137-Tris | [DSMZ394](https://www.dsmz.de/microorganisms/medium/pdf/DSMZ_Medium394.pdf) and [DSMZ1137](https://www.dsmz.de/microorganisms/medium/pdf/DSMZ_Medium1137.pdf) specify a 1 M Tris-HCl stock at pH7.5, with different receiving doses. |
| CHEM-C1193-JCM_1061-Tris | [JCM1061](https://www.jcm.riken.jp/cgi-bin/jcm/jcm_grmd?GRMD=1061) specifies a 0.5 M Tris-HCl stock at pH8.0. |

All five primary documents were fetched successfully for this check. None enumerates the proposed stock's preparation inputs. The candidates nevertheless use `RECIPE_TRANSCRIPTION` to assert total buffer moieties and potassium-containing or chloride species as material components. Those descriptions are inferred chemical/speciation categories. Under MAPPING_SEMANTICS section6, an ion or speciation bridge cannot stand in for a material has-part assertion. Nominal stock strength does not establish free-base/salt fractions, potassium stoichiometry or separately supplied free KOH/HCl. Merely changing the assertion method would not make these material inputs supported.

The bounded correction is to omit the unsupported `components` and their paired `component_assertion`, while retaining the useful whole-stock names, source-stated strengths/pH, exact occurrence routing, evidence, original history and explicit unknown composition. Do not substitute dry Tris hydrochloride, infer solvent or titration inputs, borrow receiving-medium water/pH, or treat unknown stock details as proof that the two HEPES preparations differ. This does not change the separate solid Tris-HCl parent-grade finding in #1238. Full successor review and native validation remain required; no owner, role or export approval follows.

Reproduction is saved at `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/buffer-source-parts-triage-v1/`. Original finding SHA256s: `ef1bc8a7f7ea8ff459305fb71b1864baec2d3c8fff72df3855d79b428aea0f49` and `99be33af59ae5ea2abad4f7df98b414b528147047076357bc5b21b48043412f9`. Reconcile the overlapping supported partial-preparation scope into one justified nominal candidate or establish a positive material distinction before co-installation. Do not infer complete formulation equivalence from the same listed solute/strength; unknown solvent/batch details are neither proof of equality nor disjointness. Preserve both exact source/case lineages and the literal seven waters without silently converting to conventional Mohr hexahydrate. The sealed review's stronger early phrase "same stock" is qualified by its final root adjudication, which does not assert full composition equivalence.

The separate W02-F-PREPARATIONS DSMZ375/1107 cysteine overlap is a second family dependency under1201. Keep375's unknown strength/solvent/filtration distinct from1107's explicit5%w/v scope; do not create a chemically disjoint owner solely because source numbers differ. These exact families were not present in the previously sealed1237 family packet (ignored-inclusive comparison); this comment adds scope without duplicating its common identity rule.

Four-family independent review follow-up: two minor Columbia evidence-packet findings, with the ownership block retained.

The completed W06 review covers the exact DAIGO188/474, phosphate873/940, Hutner624/657 and Columbia300/921 candidates: eight origins, twelve source cases and fifteen CultureMech occurrences. Its three independent reviewer scopes and native saved review were checked. The 315-member review packet and 347-member author packet rehash. Ten-vitamin573/810 is excluded from scientific acceptance because W06 authored an origin.

- **W06-FF-001 / FFA-001 — frozen M2224 recipe binding.** The author packet references the full `columbia_blood_agar_oxoid.yaml` recipe but does not carry its bytes. The original frozen queue copy and independently recovered copy both hash to `2db87e5a52686a3592ac32eafdd18b2a9ddb64f849469d73f06f9483ad23e0a8`. Bind that exact complete recipe and its source-case/occurrence in a new immutable handoff, preserving the old packet. No formula change is required.
- **W06-FF-002 / FFA-002 — qualify the current Difco 44 g contrast.** The exact original W10 capture `9d330adf2da453b5e03f506b7f37fcca3f39dfb0f36cee6b6357914cefaaa1fb` contains a substantive indexed extraction from the official BD manual: the seven-part Difco Columbia table and 44 g instruction, separately from the BBL table. It is not merely a title, and no contradiction of 44 g was established. The author packet carries the evidence-ledger reference but not this capture. The direct PDF request failed, so a complete PDF/page-image verification must not be claimed. Either bind the exact indexed capture and state those retrieval limits, or remove the unnecessary numeric contrast from current notes. Preserve the inherited history verbatim. This does not create a universal full-PDF gate.

DAIGO's nominal product scope, the two equal-volume 1 M phosphate inputs, and the nominal Hutner family remain supported within their existing limits. Preserve the 3.15 g versus 3.2 g DAIGO distinction, unknown phosphate carrier/hydration/pH, the Hutner 3.335 g versus 3.34 g precision, malformed molybdate literals, nested stock/process unknowns and all genuine source holds. An existing Metals44 alias match does not itself authorize a chemically complete nested-stock reference.

**Columbia remains `BLOCKED_OWNER_CONTINUITY`.** Support for the nominal Oxoid 39 g formulation does not partition the authentic mixed `UNMAPPED_0118` owner, assign a historical catalog code to M2224, establish a prepared blood-agar product, or approve a role or export. Preserve the genuine Oxoid/Difco source histories until an explicit owner-boundary decision and all required couplings are reviewed.

All eight currently published origins were rebound to their exact cases and payloads. Six payloads are unchanged. W07 origins624/657 at `ee75d464c4a44edfbc57c72c200eeeaf962a7192` have only the approved mapping-evidence type correction and appended history; their selector expressly forbids separate co-installation. Carry that current provenance through the shared candidate successor without choosing an individual winner. This mechanical bridge is not a substitute for the separate W07 successor review or final integrated application review.

Evidence: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/four-family-review-triage-v1/{HANDOFF.json,disposition-matrix.json,current-origin-bridges.json,FF002-independent-qualification.json}`. Original W06 native review SHA256 `fb76dd2554d57e225fbdca8bce51091be81c2b640bc4c2f35fdd8b0dc8db2830`; its first category/key validation failure and the native metadata-only correction are retained. Independent follow-up `W10-SV3-SKEPTIC-CALF-BLOOD-WORDING` is confirmed against published W10 head `c9a96da71a1977014680e5a92e600dfc7e3874db`. This is a minor explanation error in proposal `sv1-bio-calf_blood_togo_m2854`, case 44; the source-supported blood identity and broader blood mapping remain intact.

The active notes, mapping-evidence explanation and proposal description say “Calf age class distinguishes it from serum.” Age and material fraction are separate attributes: calf serum also exists. The exact [TOGO M2854 recipe](https://togomedium.org/sparqlist/api/gmdb_medium_by_gmid?gm_id=M2854) names **calf blood** at a literal 10% receiving dose. It does not explicitly say “whole,” specify a percentage basis, or establish defibrination, lysis or a commercial product. The root readback verified the committed source capture `12f6464a1dcc66a32160e85433034cfd067ea5e930f3ae6d12ce2c60d6af2770` and selected payload `62f0dc3300c488be2fb9d52f2c65e8e6826715d81177cf8e4ce48af422ed7338`.

Bounded correction: state that the source names calf blood, a blood material rather than serum, while calf specifies developmental origin. Correct current explanatory fields and any exact active case/proposal reasoning that repeats the error. Preserve the original historical event verbatim and append a truthful correction event. Keep the source label, identifier, mapping, unknown processing, unknown percentage basis, source-specific applicability, nonresolving generic label and all role/export holds unchanged. Do not infer a new product or expand aliases.

This was disclosed by a separate skeptical reviewer before any fix; the provenance-only correction did not endorse the inherited wording. Make an immutable successor with exact changed-field accounting, native checks and independent review. Current issue search found no separate calf-blood wording tracker, so this follow-up stays on the existing family issue. Private evidence and the original finding are retained under `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/w10-calf-wording-triage-v1/`.

Independent ten-vitamin reconciliation found four concrete source/owner conditions, tracked here before any correction (TV-001 through TV-004).

1. **TV-001 — ATCC owner protocol/product scope.** The maintained `ATCC_Wolfes_Vitamin_Mix` component list cites the ten-vitamin ATCC2672 protocol without phosphate, while its history identifies MD-VS. The current official [MD-VS formulation](https://www.atcc.org/products/md-vs) includes monopotassium phosphate at 900 mg/L. Both inspected upstream CultureBotHT exact ATCC-name definitions identify MD-VS and contain phosphate. Preserve these distinct source claims and original history; source-definition linkage does not prove a purchased lot or historical lot composition.
2. **TV-002 — listed water is not exact final volume.** The protocol tables list batch solute masses and 1 L distilled water input. They do not establish a make-to-volume instruction. The maintained protocol-derived MG_PER_L and L_PER_L values need correction or an explicit independently evidenced basis. MD-VS's directly printed mg/L values are a different source claim. Do not infer displacement, density or a final-volume denominator.
3. **TV-003 — existing generic owner continuity.** `Wolfes_Vitamin_Mix` originates in CultureBotHT, then acquires a phosphate-containing NCMA component assertion. The inspected upstream generic definitions contain ten vitamins, no phosphate, and explicit cyanocobalamin. Reconcile the authentic original/current source lineage before reusing this owner or minting a new nominal ten-vitamin owner. This does not prove the NCMA formula is wrong, and generic B12 must not silently become cyanocobalamin in the JCM/NBRC recipe.
4. **TV-004 — nonuniform ATCC X1 scale.** The upstream exact ATCC definition labels X=1. Its ten vitamin values are one hundredth of the current MD-VS concentrations after unit comparison, while phosphate 0.9 g/L equals MD-VS 900 mg/L. A single dilution factor cannot reconcile the whole block. Preserve raw quantities, forms and X metadata and establish stock versus receiving-medium scope; do not silently repair the source.

The independently supported immediate result is one source-qualified nominal JCM197/NBRC837/NBRC903 recipe representation, preserving all ten literal vitamins, 1 L water input and each preparation method. There is a positive boundary from the MD-VS product/source-definition scope; a missing D stereochemical qualifier is not evidence of a distinct substance. Creating a fresh owner remains blocked on the genuine generic-owner continuity decision. Perfect molecular specification is not a prerequisite for documenting the nominal recipe.

The review accounts for eight cases and 71 CultureMech occurrences, with six excluded contexts and 84 separate KG holds. Its 65-context upper bound is not blanket mapping approval. Current W06 `1d62a4084cda998064110c0e6ddfbf943b52c3de` and W08 `1701ccf2049022866adfcebcc9bba9b6492407c6` origins are explicitly bridged. The new W08 component bindings and exact alias need their own field-level review; no role, whole-owner or export approval is conferred.

Evidence: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/workers/w07/worktree/.temp/ten-vitamin-owner-boundary-independent-v1/`, active `HANDOFF-v2.json` SHA256 `5c57ac577453d1a7dc19444b7d50bff5c37d9b6367915114d673034421871c77`, manifest `a8082a5bd23dbad4cf5eaacea475a1ec6474c79169edea68fdb37737be7d2cfd` (683 members rehashed by coordinator), scientific adjudication `e9badf652fced9acc15e01a9f1ccd7a575360cf11d568b50aee760ac07a5ed01`. Exact primary captures, original owner beforeimages, source routes and three independent reviewer scopes are retained. No maintained correction has been applied.
